main_text.p: te fuam vfurpet,ne tecum conuerfetur vt domina,vfurpans fibi quod eft mariti. Præcipit hæc fententia moderationem ac temperantiam in amanda coniuge: nam fi amor viri in vxorem eft vehementior, ita inuertit ordinem naturæ, vt mulier quæ ὑποτάσσεσθαι[?] hoc eft fubiecta viro, effe debebat, eum fibi fubjiciat, atq; inde exiftat γυναικοκρατία[?] imperium muliebre contra ordinationem Dei occupatum. Quare beneuolentia debita quam præcipit Paulus 1.Cor.7. vxori tribuenda eft, nō ea amoris vehementia atq; impotentia, qua vir in poteftatem eius redigatur.

Vnde & confundaris) vt effeminatus, exemplo Samfonis: de quo Ambrofius, Samfon validus & fortis leonem fuffocauit, fed amorem fuum fuffocare non potuit: vincula rupit hoftium, fed fuarum non foluit ne-xus cupiditatum: meffes incendit alienas, fed vnius ipfe mulieris accenfus igniculo meffem fuæ virtutis amisit.
Cæterum ex his etiam vxor intelligere poteft, quomodo fe erga maritum gerere debeat, nempe etiam abftinere à zelo feu obtrectatione: item fubdita effe, & non αὐθεντεῖν[?] ἀνδρός.
3 Sequentes fententiæ monent vitandas effe occafiones libidinum, & fugiendam effe fcortationem. Non enim ideo licet impune fcortari, quia non licet zelare. Inquit igitur,
Ne refpicias mulierem multiuolam )quæ nunc hunc cupit, nunc aliū:vel, ne occurrito mulieri meretricanti, qualem describit Sapiens

page.notes: Running head "NVPTIALES." is set in a spaced, partly capital form and is read as a Latin title. The Greek words (ὑποτάσσεσθαι, γυναικοκρατία, αὐθεντεῖν) are small and blurred; their letters are uncertain and marked [?]. "temperantiam" is broken at a line end with no visible hyphen, so its split is doubtful. The line "Prou.7." sits below the text block and is treated as a reference note. The last word "Sapiens" is split as "Sapi-ens" across the line end; the second part is on the final line. No verse or heading is printed on this page.
